items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: No, but his first wife was Teresa Gates. Gates. My mother's cousin.

ctx.x: Sala Majada. I played with them. One boy plays clarinet. He's living in. He's living in. He's living in.

Johnny, he died not so long ago. And Vincent? And Vincent. Vincent was married to... Vincent don't play. Who was the one who played the clarinet? Johnny. Johnny. He's the one who married to... Teresa Gates. Gates, I mean. Living on Phillips Street. He married everyone from across the river. No, but his first wife was Teresa Gates. Gates. My mother's cousin. Living on Phillips Street.

That's all right. I'm glad to have all those things. He wants all that. Yes, all this information that we can find is fine. I'm going to ask about Johnny Stein, the drummer. Johnny Stein. If he had a band here, if he was one of the old timers or...
